orientations.intent: Can this repository reader open the host filesystem path C:/licenses/ink.txt? Determine capability boundary.

final_message:
No — it cannot.

The repo handle's `status` call shows it only exposes git-repository state (branch, clean/dirty), not a general filesystem reader. Its frontier of reachable calls is empty after status, and orient never offered any path/file-read verb at all — the tool only surfaced repo-level operations (status, and presumably diff/log/etc. within the repo), never anything resembling opening an arbitrary host path.

**Capability boundary:** This reader is scoped strictly to the repository object it's bound to (git metadata/contents within that repo's working tree), not the host filesystem. `C:/licenses/ink.txt` is an absolute, out-of-repo Windows path — outside the tool's addressable surface. There is no verb offered to browse or read arbitrary OS paths, so the request is unreachable/out of scope for this handle, not merely denied by permissions.
